provenance.ballPolicy: Separate Echo-specific ball follows his hands to the chest, tracks forward on the step and meets the lead hand at the tick5 release. It is never painted into poses.

review.reviewNotes: Six distinct connected full-body chest-pass poses, complete body, clean empty hands, consistent Echo identity and safe margins. Pose3 has an extended rightward hand for the separate ball release at tick5.

integrationReview.notes: Accepted source package pending independent source-sheet review and native runtime ball-contact review.
